status: Audit-derived integration requirements; not production implementation or activation

counterexample.fixed_layout: 61/62 duties, gap1; one duty has zero clear candidates
counterexample.reviewed_unit_change: 62/62 duties, gap1, OT feasible, fixed assignment unchanged

observed_integration_assumptions.finding: Candidate variables and decisions reference existing fixed-unit slots; generated alternatives currently vary people, not unit placement.
Application validates existing ORM slots and people; a unit-layout proposal requires an explicit before/after unit representation and atomic final-set validation before persistence.
Review export reads the actual slot unit. A future staged unit change must be rendered from the selected proposal without mutating saved slots.
Existing balance operations demonstrate attributable cross-unit before-images, original-state checks and exact undo, but operate on already filled duties.

required_proposal_fields: unchanged duty type, call-level pool, date and interval
canonical context hash including rules, leave, postings, OT and scope
review_requirements: Clearly show old and new unit, person and call level before Apply
Include unit moves in the selected Excel preview and workload comparison
State that a timeout is not proof that other layouts are infeasible
atomic_apply_requirements: Use existing input locks and stale-context checks
Verify original slot/unit and fixed signatures before mutation
Construct an isolated proposed context; avoid ORM autoflush of temporary unit changes
Validate every proposed and affected preserved duty against the complete final schedule, including next-month rest and global OT matching
Persist slot-unit changes and assignments in one transaction with attributable before-images
Roll back all unit/assignment changes if any validation, concurrent edit or commit check fails
acceptance_cases: Reproduce the known dated_fixed shortage and recover62/62 without clinical-policy changes
Review/export must show selected proposed unit while saved unit remains unchanged
A concurrent unit, leave, OT, posting, lock or rule edit rejects the stale proposal
Wrong call, leave, rest, quota, OT or unit eligibility cannot be waived by layout repair
Failure halfway through apply leaves every original unit/person/assignment intact
A locked empty duty remains visible and cannot be moved
Alternatives remain distinct and never regress approved higher-priority objectives
Undo, if exposed, refuses intervening edits and restores exact before-images
gates: Retain N26/N27 architecture and acceptance prerequisites
No new policy, cloud routing or deployment authority inferred
All50tracker items and existing unrelated work remain preserved
next_concrete_action: Extend the canonical reviewed proposal representation for explicit unit changes, then verify preview/export and atomic apply together before activating production template repair.
